components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink action for indexing a note.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #17211f; color: #f2f5f2; padding: 0 12px; height: 40px; letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 800; border: 1px solid #17211f; border-radius: 0; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c84935; border-color: #c84935; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c84935; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Signal Button
components.description: Vermilion action for retrieving the current question.
components.css: .ds-btn-signal { background: #c84935; color: #fff8f4; padding: 0 15px; height: 41px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 800; border: 0; border-radius: 0; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-signal:hover { background: #91382b; } .ds-btn-signal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c84935; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The question line where retrieval begins.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; min-height: 57px; border: 1px solid #a9b5b1; padding: 7px 8px 7px 17px; background: #f2f5f2; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #17211f; font: 14px 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #c84935; outline: 2px solid #c84935; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Evidence Row
components.description: Flat ranked passage row with source and match signal.
components.css: .ds-evidence { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px 1fr 45px; gap: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 15px 10px 15px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #c7cfcc; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #17211f; text-align: left; } .ds-evidence small { display: block; color: #1d6f73; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .09em; } .ds-evidence strong { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-evidence em { display: block; margin-top: 6px; color: #5f6d68; font-size: 12px; font-style: normal; } .ds-evidence b { color: #91382b; font-size: 15px; } .ds-evidence:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c84935; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Tracework is a cool drafting surface for personal memory: orderly enough to trust, visibly marked enough to question. The UI is built from ruled lanes, registration marks, and tonal paper layers. It refuses a generic chat room as the primary composition; the answer, ranked evidence, and inspected source belong to one working view.

The system is light because the product is used at a desk beside real code and notes. Ink-black text carries the working material, teal labels name the system, and vermilion appears as a deliberate signal for active retrieval and provenance.
keyCharacteristics: Cool mineral paper and a drafting-table rail
Hairline rules and registration marks instead of decorative cards
One vermilion signal for active retrieval and source focus
Evidence rows and source inspection as the signature interaction

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks what is active or needs attention. Do not scatter it across decorative accents.

rules.name: The Question Leads Rule
rules.body: The visitor's question is the largest readable object in the first workbench view; supporting labels stay subordinate.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Evidence stays on the page and in the reading flow; never hide provenance in a floating or modal surface.

dos: Do keep the question, answer, evidence, and source inspector in one visible workflow.
Do use vermilion sparingly for active retrieval and provenance.
Do preserve source title, path, chunk offset, and embedding version whenever a result is rendered.
donts: Don't replace the evidence stream with a generic chat transcript.
Don't use colored borders, gradients, or floating card stacks as decoration.
Don't present weak near-matches as grounded citations.
